name: Make music / audio (Lyria music generation)
ui_location: Composer quick-action chip 'Create music' OR Tools drawer (#toolbox-drawer-menu) -> 'Create music' menuitemcheckbox; result is an inline music player with a Download track format menu
recipe: Navigate https://gemini.google.com/app (fresh composer).

Click button[aria-label="\ud83c\udfb8 Create music, button, tap to use tool"] (emoji prefix literal). Alt: open Tools (xpath //button[.//text()[contains(.,"Tools")] or @aria-label="Tools"]) then click xpath //*[@id="toolbox-drawer-menu"]//button[normalize-space(.)="Create music"].
Selected when button[aria-label="Deselect Create music"] + button[aria-label="Play or pause audio preview"] appear; composer placeholder becomes 'Describe your track'.
browser:type into div[aria-label="Enter a prompt for Gemini"] a benign instrumental prompt (no copyrighted content). Press Escape to dismiss ul#auto-suggest-0-0.
browser:click button[aria-label="Send message"] --confirmed true (RISK_WORDS guard matches 'send'; --confirmed is the sanctioned benign-send bypass).
Generating: 'Music Generating your music...' + button[aria-label="Stop response"]; URL -> /app/<conversationId>.
Poll browser:read until button[aria-label="Stop response"] gone and button[aria-label="Download track"] present (~20-30s).

Capture: browser:artifact-click --profile gemini-9225 --tab-url-contains <conversationId> --button-selector 'button[aria-label="Download track"]' --follow-up-text-regex 'MP3' --download-dir <abs> --locate-timeout-ms 20000 --prerender-wait-ms 1500
completion_gate: button[aria-label="Download track"] present AND button[aria-label="Stop response"] absent; also button[aria-label="Listen"], input[aria-label="Seek slider"], duration timer span appear.
artifact: 'Download track' opens dynamic mat-menu (#mat-menu-panel-N) with 'Video Audio with cover art' and 'Audio only MP3 track'. Two-stage artifact-click (button + --follow-up-text-regex 'MP3'). VERIFIED: .runs/web-ai-explore/stream5/artifacts/Paper_Keys.mp3 744610 bytes, file(1)='MPEG ADTS layer III v1 192 kbps 44.1 kHz JntStereo'.
notes: QUIRK: Download track is NOT direct - opens format submenu (2nd click). mat-menu panel id dynamic; target menuitems by follow-up-text-regex. Sub-MCP rationale: Lyria is a large self-contained module (player widget, format menu, share-track, video render) distinct from text chat -> good gemini-music sub-MCP.
